title: Vesperquartz Reliquaries
description: A lightweight, vanilla-friendly datapack that adds mysterious ruins, relic sites, shrines, wayposts, hidden cellars, and lootable structures to Minecraft world generation.
body:
![Structures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52758d11192887dc2dc9247067a1eb259823bb12.png)

**Vesperquartz Reliquaries** is a lightweight Minecraft datapack that adds mysterious overworld ruins, relic sites, small camps, hidden cellars, crystal shrines, and lootable structures to world generation.

Explore your world and discover forgotten wayposts, buried rune cellars, strange pillars, starlit wells, crystal monuments, ruined cairns, and cozy woodland lodges. Each structure is designed to feel vanilla-friendly while adding more atmosphere and reasons to explore.

### Features
Adds multiple new naturally generating structures
Includes lootable chests and barrels
Vanilla-style ruins, shrines, camps, and relic sites
Works in many overworld biomes
Some structures can also appear in harsher environments such as deserts, mountains, badlands, and the Nether
Balanced exploration loot
Includes function commands for testing and manual placement
No mods required — datapack only
Added Structures

- **Driftwood Waypost** — a small abandoned travel stop with supplies
- **Sunken Rune Cellar** — a buried underground relic chamber
- **Ashen Pillar** — a rare dark pillar structure found in harsh biomes
- **Crystal Obelisk** — a glowing quartz-themed monument
- **Ruined Cairn** — a small forgotten ruin with buried rewards
- **Fernkeeper Lodge** — a cozy overgrown woodland shelter
- **Starlit Well** — a magical-looking well structure
and more small relic sites to discover
Loot

Structures may contain chests or barrels with useful exploration rewards such as:

- food
- tools
- ores and minerals
- amethyst and quartz-themed items
- rare materials
- utility items
- occasional treasure items

Loot is meant to be useful without feeling overpowered.

### Compatibility

Designed for Minecraft 1.21.4+ and future compatible versions.

The datapack uses modern Minecraft worldgen structure formats, so very old versions such as 1.12.x are not supported.
